```python
import polars as pl

# Create a DataFrame with duplicate rows
df = pl.DataFrame({
    "A": [1, 2, 3, 2, 1, 4],
    "B": ["x", "y", "z", "y", "x", "w"],
    "C": [10, 20, 30, 20, 10, 40]
})

# Remove duplicates, keeping the first occurrence
df_unique = df.unique(maintain_order=True)

print(df_unique)
```
